dct_title_s: Paſcaerte van't Weſtlycke Deel vam Oost Indien, van Cabo de Bona Eſperanca  tot C. Comorin
dct_description_sm: The sea is decorated with two sailing vessels and one compass rose with rhumb lines that extend over southern Arabia and the west coast of India. Cartouche includes two Africans in oriental costume and four children.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0244, p. 280
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0244.
